#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

using ll = long long;
using pii = pair<int, int>;

const ll INF = 1e18;

struct Edge {
    int to, rev;
    ll cap, cost;
    Edge(int t, int r, ll c, ll co) : to(t), rev(r), cap(c), cost(co) {}
};

class MCMF {
public:
    int n;
    vector<vector<Edge>> graph;
    vector<ll> dist, potential;
    vector<int> prevv, preve;
    
    MCMF(int nodes) : n(nodes) {
        graph.resize(n);
        dist.resize(n);
        potential.resize(n, 0);
        prevv.resize(n);
        preve.resize(n);
    }
    
    void add_edge(int from, int to, ll cap, ll cost) {
        graph[from].emplace_back(to, graph[to].size(), cap, cost);
        graph[to].emplace_back(from, graph[from].size() - 1, 0, -cost);
    }
    
    pair<ll, ll> min_cost_flow(int s, int t, ll f) {
        ll res = 0;
        while (f > 0) {
            fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), INF);
            dist[s] = 0;
            bool update = true;
            while (update) {
                update = false;
                for (int v = 0; v < n; v++) {
                    if (dist[v] == INF) continue;
                    for (int i = 0; i < graph[v].size(); i++) {
                        Edge &e = graph[v][i];
                        if (e.cap > 0 && dist[e.to] > dist[v] + e.cost + potential[v] - potential[e.to]) {
                            dist[e.to] = dist[v] + e.cost + potential[v] - potential[e.to];
                            prevv[e.to] = v;
                            preve[e.to] = i;
                            update = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (dist[t] == INF) {
                return {res, -1};
            }
            for (int v = 0; v < n; v++) {
                potential[v] += dist[v];
            }
            ll d = f;
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevv[v]) {
                d = min(d, graph[prevv[v]][preve[v]].cap);
            }
            f -= d;
            res += d * potential[t];
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevv[v]) {
                Edge &e = graph[prevv[v]][preve[v]];
                e.cap -= d;
                graph[v][e.rev].cap += d;
            }
        }
        return {res, res};
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int n, m, k;
    ll c, d;
    cin >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d;
    
    vector<vector<int>> adj(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
        int u, v;
        cin >> u >> v;
        u--; v--;
        adj[u].push_back(v);
        adj[v].push_back(u);
    }
    
    vector<int> a(k);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        cin >> a[i];
        a[i]--;
    }
    
    vector<vector<ll>> dist(n, vector<ll>(n, INF));
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        dist[i][i] = 0;
        queue<int> q;
        q.push(i);
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front(); q.pop();
            for (int v : adj[u]) {
                if (dist[i][v] == INF) {
                    dist[i][v] = dist[i][u] + 1;
                    q.push(v);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    vector<ll> min_time(k);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        min_time[i] = dist[a[i]][0];
    }
    
    sort(min_time.begin(), min_time.end());
    
    ll ans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        ans += c * min_time[i];
    }
    
    vector<pair<int, int>> edges_list;
    for (int u = 0; u < n; u++) {
        for (int v : adj[u]) {
            if (u < v) {
                edges_list.push_back({u, v});
            }
        }
    }
    
    vector<vector<int>> person_on_edge(edges_list.size(), vector<int>(k, 0));
    
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        int node = a[i];
        int time = 0;
        while (node != 0) {
            int next_node = -1;
            for (int neighbor : adj[node]) {
                if (dist[a[i]][neighbor] == dist[a[i]][node] - 1) {
                    next_node = neighbor;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (next_node == -1) break;
            
            int edge_idx = -1;
            for (int j = 0; j < (int)edges_list.size(); j++) {
                if ((edges_list[j].first == node && edges_list[j].second == next_node) ||
                    (edges_list[j].first == next_node && edges_list[j].second == node)) {
                    edge_idx = j;
                    break;
                }
            }
            
            if (edge_idx != -1) {
                person_on_edge[edge_idx][i] = time;
            }
            
            node = next_node;
            time++;
        }
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)edges_list.size(); i++) {
        vector<int> times;
        for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) {
            if (person_on_edge[i][j] > 0) {
                times.push_back(person_on_edge[i][j]);
            }
        }
        sort(times.begin(), times.end());
        
        for (int j = 0; j < (int)times.size(); j++) {
            ans += d * (2LL * (j + 1) - 1);
        }
    }
    
    cout << ans << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
